landing.heroTitle: Kadi moja ya harusi: inafika kwa kila mgeni, inajibu, inachangia, inaingia mlangoni.
landing.heroBody: WhatsApp, SMS au karatasi — kila mgeni anapata kadi yake yenye QR na namba. Hata bila smartphone, hata bila mtandao.

1.title: Ingiza wageni
1.body: Bandika orodha, pakia CSV au chagua kutoka kwenye anwani za simu. Tunasafisha namba zote.

2.title: Tuma kadi
2.body: WhatsApp kwa wenye smartphone, SMS kwa wengine, na PDF ya kuchapisha kwa wazee.

3.title: Wageni wajibu & walipe
3.body: Mgeni anathibitisha kuhudhuria na kulipa mchango kwa simu — bila kuingia kwenye akaunti.

4.title: Wafike langoni
4.body: Kamati inaskani QR au kuandika namba. Inafanya kazi hata mtandao ukikatika.

landing.featureBody: Kila mgeni anapata namba fupi kama KH-4826 kwenye SMS au kadi ya karatasi. Mlangoni, kamati inaitafuta kwa namba, jina au tarakimu nne za mwisho za simu.
landing.featurePrint: Kadi ya karatasi yenye QR na namba

sender.title: Mtumaji anaonekana
sender.body: Kila kadi inaonyesha jina la kamati, simu yao na kiungo rasmi.

links.title: Hakuna viungo vya ulaghai
links.body: Hatuombi nenosiri wala PIN, na hatutumi viambatisho au programu.

data.title: Data zako ni zako
data.body: Namba za wageni zinatumika kwa harusi yako tu. Unaweza kuzipakua au kuzifuta wakati wowote.

1.q: Je, kadi ya karatasi bado inawezekana?
1.a: Ndiyo. Unapakua PDF ya kadi zote — kila moja ina QR na namba ya mgeni — na kuchapisha popote.

2.q: Mgeni asiye na smartphone atapataje kadi?
2.a: Atapokea SMS yenye kiungo kifupi na namba ya kadi. Mlangoni anataja namba tu.

3.q: Itakuwaje mtandao ukikatika siku ya harusi?
3.a: Programu ya mlangoni inahakiki QR bila mtandao na kusawazisha baadaye. Kadi ya mgeni pia inaonekana bila mtandao baada ya kufunguliwa mara ya kwanza.

4.a: Mgeni analipa kwa M-Pesa, Mixx by Yas, Airtel Money au HaloPesa kutoka kwenye kadi yake. Kamati inaweza pia kurekodi malipo ya taslimu.

5.q: Mtu akipiga picha ya QR ya mwingine?
5.a: Kila QR ni ya mgeni mmoja na inaweza kuingia mara moja. Ikiskaniwa mara ya pili, kamati inaona ni nani aliingia na saa ngapi.

6.a: Wakati wa majaribio ni bure. Gharama za SMS zinaonyeshwa kabla ya kutuma.

privacy.intro: Kadi Sasa inakusanya taarifa chache zinazohitajika kutuma mialiko, kupokea majibu na michango, na kuingiza wageni mlangoni. Tunafuata Sheria ya Ulinzi wa Taarifa Binafsi ya Tanzania (2022).
privacy.collect: Jina la mgeni, namba ya simu (ikiwa ipo), jibu la mwaliko, idadi ya watu, ahadi na malipo, na kumbukumbu ya kuingia mlangoni.
privacy.use: Kwa harusi husika tu: kutuma kadi na vikumbusho, kuonyesha hali kwa kamati, na kuthibitisha kuingia. Hatuuzi wala kushiriki data na watangazaji.
privacy.rights: Unaweza kuomba nakala ya taarifa zako au zifutwe kwa kuwasiliana na kamati ya harusi au sisi. Wenye harusi wanaweza kupakua au kufuta data kutoka kwenye akaunti yao.
privacy.security: Viungo vya kadi ni vya kipekee na havitabiriki. Hatuombi nenosiri, PIN wala namba za siri kutoka kwa wageni.

terms.intro: Kwa kutumia Kadi Sasa unakubali masharti haya ya rasimu.
terms.account: Wenye harusi na kamati wanaingia kwa namba ya simu na namba ya uthibitisho. Unawajibika kwa taarifa za wageni unazoingiza.
terms.messages: Tuma mialiko kwa watu unaowafahamu tu. Usitumie huduma kutuma matangazo.
terms.payments: Michango inalipwa kupitia watoa huduma wa malipo walioidhinishwa. Kadi Sasa haihifadhi PIN za malipo.
terms.liability: Huduma inatolewa kama ilivyo wakati wa majaribio.

landing.heroTitle: One wedding card that reaches every guest, collects replies and contributions, and opens the gate.
landing.heroBody: WhatsApp, SMS or paper — every guest gets their own card with a QR and a number. Even without a smartphone, even without a network.

1.title: Add guests
1.body: Paste a list, upload a CSV or pick from phone contacts. We clean up every number.

2.title: Send cards
2.body: WhatsApp for smartphones, SMS for everyone else, and a printable PDF for elders.

3.title: Guests reply & pay
3.body: Guests confirm and pay their contribution by phone — no account needed.

4.title: Arrive at the gate
4.body: The committee scans the QR or types the number. It works even when the network drops.

landing.featureBody: Every guest gets a short number like KH-4826 by SMS or on a paper card. At the gate, the committee finds them by number, name or the last four digits of their phone.
landing.featureSms: An SMS that reads on any phone
landing.featurePrint: A paper card with QR and number
landing.featureGate: At the gate: QR, number or name

sender.title: You can see who sent it
sender.body: Every card shows the committee's name, their phone and the official link.

links.title: No scam links
links.body: We never ask for passwords or PINs, and we never send attachments or apps.

data.title: Your data stays yours
data.body: Guest numbers are used for your wedding only. Download or delete them at any time.

1.q: Can we still have paper cards?
1.a: Yes. Download a PDF of all cards — each with the guest's QR and number — and print anywhere.

2.q: How does a guest without a smartphone get a card?
2.a: They receive an SMS with a short link and their card number. At the gate they just say the number.

3.q: What if the network drops on the wedding day?
3.a: The gate app checks QR codes without a network and syncs later. The guest's card also shows offline after the first open.

4.a: Guests pay with M-Pesa, Mixx by Yas, Airtel Money or HaloPesa from their card. The committee can also record cash.

5.q: What if someone photographs another guest's QR?
5.a: Each QR belongs to one guest and admits once. A second scan shows the committee who entered and when.

6.a: It is free during the pilot. SMS costs are shown before sending.

landing.footerTagline: Made in Tanzania for Tanzanian weddings.

privacy.intro: Kadi Sasa collects the minimum needed to send invitations, receive replies and contributions, and admit guests at the gate. We follow Tanzania's Personal Data Protection Act (2022).
privacy.collect: Guest name, phone number (if any), RSVP, party size, pledges and payments, and the gate check-in record.
privacy.use: For that wedding only: sending cards and reminders, showing status to the committee, and confirming entry. We do not sell or share data with advertisers.
privacy.rights: You can request a copy of your data or its deletion through the wedding committee or us. Couples can download or delete data from their account.
privacy.security: Card links are unique and unguessable. We never ask guests for passwords, PINs or secret codes.

terms.intro: By using Kadi Sasa you accept these draft terms.
terms.account: Couples and committee members sign in with a phone number and a confirmation code. You are responsible for the guest information you enter.
terms.messages: Only invite people you know. Do not use the service for advertising.
terms.payments: Contributions are paid through licensed payment providers. Kadi Sasa never stores payment PINs.
terms.liability: The service is provided as is during the pilot.
